source: git archive into an empty /tmp directory, no virtualenv or node_modules
host_ports: removed only to avoid conflicts with the running main demo
build: docker compose -p marketpulse-clean -f compose.yaml -f compose.verify.yaml build; existing dependency-layer cache reused
start: MP_LAB_ENABLED=true docker compose -p marketpulse-clean -f compose.yaml -f compose.verify.yaml up -d --no-build
demo: docker compose -p marketpulse-clean -f compose.yaml -f compose.verify.yaml exec -T api marketpulse demo
checks: Full proxy/API/warehouse read and ten SQL checks passed

result.volume_unit: base asset units; bars, not quote volume
